title: Strong, Unpleasant Odor on These Spoons
text:
Strong, Unpleasant Odor on These Spoons. A good set of measuring spoons is essential for the kitchen though they come in handy in other contexts too. I have several sets, and I was eager to try these as KitchenAid is a solid name in kitchen appliances and some household items as well. I will confess to being somewhat disappointed in this set. Aside from being short-handled, they have a terrible odor right out of the box that bothers me a lot.

This is a set of 5 measuring spoons – 1/4 teaspoon, 1/2 teaspoon, 1 teaspoon, 1/2 tablespoon and 1 tablespoon. Of these four of them are what I would call essential. The 1/2 tablespoon seems like an odd measure that have, especially in a small set. I have used other sets that come with a spoon of that size, but that set had seven spoons total and instead that particular measure was labeled as 1-1/2 teaspoon.

These seem to be made of hard, solid plastic and though they do bend a little they are mostly inflexible. You can use these to scoop things like shortening or peanut butter without concern of them snapping or breaking.

I have two issues with these. First, the handles are short. This is relative and this really is a minor quibble that comes down to personal preference. I would have liked to see longer handles on these spoons. The bigger issue with these is that they have a very distinctive and unpleasant smell. I noticed it when I opened the package and it still is on these after sitting on my desk for a couple of weeks. This is a much more serious problem and is the main reason I have issues with these spoons.

As a set of measuring spoons, this is a decent set. They seem to be of the right volume and they are made well. Unfortunately, these have a very unpleasant smell that will make me think twice before using them if I have any other set of spoons available to me.
